messages:
marta: FYI Acme reported that their Dedicated pool 'acme-prod' shows ~720 reserved GPU hours consumed on invoice but our token dashboard only shows ~120k tokens for the same period. Customer thinks they're being double-charged.
lee: OK can you paste tenant id + example invoice lines and the pool id? also any request ids the customer included?
marta: tenant_id: acme-78, pool: dedicated-acme-prod, invoice lines: UID 2026-03-01..2026-03-31 reserved_hours=720. Customer provided sample request id: req_0a9f3b2d, and a few job ids in the logs.
sam: tagging billing to hold any automated adjustments until we confirm. @billing-bot please flag invoice 2026-03-acme-78 for manual review.
billing-bot: invoice 2026-03-acme-78 flagged for manual review by billing team. :white_check_mark:
jordan: Quick hypothesis — burst capacity usage should consume burst credits, not reserved hours, but we do have a legacy quota mapping that can charge reserved pool when burst nodes are spun up in the same tenant. Need to check metering attribution logs.
lee: I want GPU utilization traces + metering events for the pool. eng-telemetry: can you run the join of compute_metering -> allocation_events for pool dedicated-acme-prod for 2026-03-15..2026-03-20? specifically look for allocation_reason = "burst" or prewarm.
eng-telemetry-bot: query started: SELECT * FROM compute_metering WHERE pool='dedicated-acme-prod' AND ts BETWEEN 1768000000 AND 1768600000 ORDER BY ts;
eng-telemetry-bot: partial result: multiple allocation events with reason=\"burst\" and allocation_duration spikes at 30-45m each during peak windows. Also saw long-running sessions where token delta << GPU time.
marta: Customer says they only run short chat completions (few hundred tokens) — so long GPU wall-time with low token delta smells like heavy KV cache usage or a model variant with REALLY slow decoding.
lee: Can you ask customer for sample curl that reproduces? also give them this quick repro to run in their staging pool (small-scale):

```
# run 100 concurrent calls to simulate burst
for i in $(seq 1 100); do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","prompt":"hi","max_tokens":50}' &
done
wait
```

lee: Also ask them to include X-Request-Id and x-redwood-pool header from their requests so we can tie to allocation events.
jordan: Another potential root cause — billing metering currently attributes GPU-hours to the tenant owning the pool, but due to a bug we recently fixed, some burst allocations on shared infra were attributed to the reserved pool when requests were routed through the tenant's gateway. That would explain reserved_hours > token burn.
sam: If telemetry confirms it, we'll need to issue an invoice credit for the misattributed hours plus SLA credit if their SLOs were impacted. Need list of misattributed allocation event ids and timestamps for audit.
lee: I'll pull the GPU-side traces and kernel durations for the sample req_0a9f3b2d. If we see long kernel stalls or slow memory swaps that explain GPU time vs tokens, we can rule out only attribution bug.
eng-telemetry-bot: trace for req_0a9f3b2d: allocated_on=gpu-72, start_ts=1768440001, end_ts=1768441802, gpu_time=1799s, tokens_emitted=372.
marta: that's ~30min of GPU for ~372 tokens. definitely anomalous.
jordan: filing internal bug: INFRA-4021 for metering attribution; attaching these allocation ids. Suspect race between allocation tagging and burst proxy attach.
lee: action items:
- eng-telemetry: full list of allocation_event ids flagged as "attributed_to_reserved" for 2026-03-01..2026-03-31 (owner: eng-telemetry, ETA 4h)
- infra: repro the race locally and write a minimal test (owner: lee, ETA 24h)
- billing: compute credits and hold invoice (owner: sam, ETA 8h after eng-telemetry results)
- support: update customer with interim status and ask for reproduction steps + headers (owner: marta, ETA 1h)
sam: If the count of misattributed hours > 10% of invoice, we pre-approve a provisional credit and will not send payment reminders until resolved.
marta: I emailed the customer the repro snippet and asked for request headers. They replied with three request ids and included a stack trace from their side showing only client-side retries.
lee: I'll need those three request ids, paste them here. also customer timezone so we match logs.
marta: pasted ids: req_0a9f3b2d, req_cb4f11a0, req_d9e5a7c2. Customer timezone: PST.
eng-telemetry-bot: pulled allocation events for supplied ids: req_cb4f11a0 allocated_on=gpu-11 duration=2100s, req_d9e5a7c2 allocated_on=gpu-11 duration=1880s. Both marked attributed_to=reserved_pool in metering table.
lee: GPU-11 shows repeated long sessions from same pool during that window. I'm confident this is attribution bug + long-running sessions. Jordan, can you confirm fix timeline?
jordan: prioritizing INFRA-4021 hotfix. If reproducer is simple will aim for patch in next deploy (ETA 12h). If not, fallback mitigation: stop attributing burst allocations to reserved pools and backfill correct tenant attribution (ETA 48h).
sam: Good. Once we have the list of allocation ids, billing will generate a credit memo and notify ops for audit. Please add the allocation_event ids to the ticket notes for compliance.
marta: I'll keep the customer updated and tell them we're pausing invoice reminders. they appreciate quick response. :pray:
lee: For records add the following local debug command to run on telemetry box to cross-check next time:

```
# cross-check metering vs compute logs
SELECT am.ts, am.allocation_id, cm.gpu_seconds, cm.tokens_emitted, cm.attributed_to
FROM allocation_meta am
JOIN compute_metering cm ON am.allocation_id = cm.allocation_id
WHERE am.pool = 'dedicated-acme-prod' AND am.ts BETWEEN 1768000000 AND 1768600000;
```

lee: saving runbook entry to /runbooks/billing-metering/ (will add after this thread).
marta: closing loop — customer confirmed they're fine waiting for investigation, asked for ETA on credits. I'll promise update tomorrow EOD PST after infra & telemetry finish.
eng-telemetry-bot: note: follow-ups scheduled. workflow: INFRA-4021 linked -> eng-telemetry to attach allocation ids -> billing to compute credit -> support to confirm with customer.
marta: thanks everyone. I'll keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
